title: Cold rebuild: make Git wait for VS Code
summary: Fix an aborting git commit and make VS Code Git's editor, diff and merge tool, from memory.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a skill stuck. In *VS Code and Git* you fixed a `git commit` that kept aborting and made VS Code Git's
editor, diff tool and merge tool. Now do it again from memory: the same scenario, **no hints, no solution to peek at**.
The checks are exactly the ones you passed the first time.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: Which file do you commit so everyone who presses F5 in the repo starts the service the same way?
steps.explain: `launch.json` holds the debug configurations. Settings change the editor's behaviour; the dev container defines the environment.

steps.title: Make Git wait for VS Code, cold
prompt: In `~/shop`, `git commit` aborts with an empty message. Fix the editor setting globally so Git waits for VS Code, and make VS Code Git's diff tool and merge tool (`vscode`).
From memory: no hints this time.
